UN Climate Body Faces Conflict of Interest, Saudi Influence Allegations

The UN climate change body has been accused of a conflict of interest and facing Saudi influence. Separately, former US President Trump has proposed a $10 billion fund for Middle East energy infrastructure projects. Meanwhile, Israel is reportedly considering assisting Saudi Arabia with alliances against the Houthi threat.
